models.name: Ward groups
models.method: k-means (scikit-learn), features standardised; water hours log-transformed
models.description: Groups wards that look alike across complaints, resolution, water and waste. Unsupervised: there are no right answers to train against, so it describes patterns rather than predicting anything.

features.label: Waste per person, kg per day (2025)

groups.label: Low waste per person, few complaints
High waste per person, many complaints

models.trained_on: 24 wards; Praja Foundation 2026 report Tables 3, 11, 43; 2025 report Tables 4, 7

models.name: Complaint forecasts
models.method: Per family of series and per forecast year, the best of three simple methods by rolling backtest at that distance (1, 2 or 3 years ahead); each year's 80% interval from that method's backtest errors
models.description: Predicts how many complaints will be registered in 2026, 2027 and 2028, with a range that widens each year. Built on ten yearly figures per series, so the ranges are wide on purpose.

methods.mean3: Average of the last three years
methods.trend: Straight-line trend over all earlier years

models.trained_on: Complaints registered 2016-2025; Praja Foundation 2026 report Tables 1, 39, 41, 43

models.name: Waste forecasts
models.method: Best of three simple methods by backtest on 2024 and 2025; 80% interval from that method's backtest errors, widened for 2027 and 2028
models.description: Predicts the tonnes of waste BMC will lift per day in 2026, 2027 and 2028, for the city and each ward. Only five years are published, so only one year ahead could be tested on two years; the 2027 and 2028 ranges are widened from that test.

methods.mean3: Average of the last three years
methods.trend: Straight-line trend over all earlier years

models.trained_on: Waste lifted per day 2021-2025; Praja Foundation 2026 report Table 37

models.name: Air-quality forecast
models.method: For each forecast year, the best of four seasonal methods by forecasting each whole year 2022-2025 from the years up to 1, 2 or 3 years before it; 80% interval from that method's errors at that distance
models.description: Predicts Mumbai's average AQI for each month of 2026, 2027 and 2028. Air quality follows a strong yearly cycle (worst in winter, best in the monsoon), so every method is built around that cycle. Each year uses the method that held up best that many years ahead.

methods.smean3: Same month, average of the last three years
methods.climatology: Same month, average of all earlier years
methods.profile: Seasonal shape of all earlier years, at last year's level

models.trained_on: Monthly average AQI 2016-2025 (120 months); Praja Foundation 2026 report Table 29

models.name: Water forecasts
models.method: Best of three simple methods by backtest on 2023 and 2024; 80% interval from that method's backtest errors, widened for later years
models.description: Predicts the share of drinking-water samples found unfit (by ward and city-wide) and the water drawn, supplied and lost in distribution city-wide, for 2025 to 2028. Water figures are published only to 2024, from five years, so only one year ahead could be tested and later ranges are widened from that test.

methods.mean3: Average of the last three years
methods.trend: Straight-line trend over all earlier years

unfit.label: Drinking-water samples unfit, wards and city

models.trained_on: Drinking-water samples unfit 2020-2024 (Praja Foundation 2025 report, Table 7); water drawn, supplied and lost FY 2019-20 to 2023-24 (Table 2)

models.name: Complaint closure forecasts
models.method: Best of three simple methods (last year, average of two years, trend) by forecasting 2025 from 2023-2024 across every ward and the city; 80% interval from those errors, widened for 2027 and 2028
models.description: Predicts the average days to close a complaint and the share of complaints closed, for each ward and the city, in 2026, 2027 and 2028. Only three years are published (2023-2025), so only one year ahead could be tested, on one year; treat 2027 and 2028 as rough.

methods.mean2: Average of the last two years
methods.trend: Straight-line trend over all earlier years

days_to_close.label: Average days to close a complaint, wards and city

closed_pct.label: Share of complaints closed (%), wards and city

models.trained_on: Complaints closed and average days to close 2023-2025; Praja Foundation 2025 and 2026 reports
